Renee (CSM): PraxisAI asked for a practical enablement that covers embeddings evaluation, rollout guardrails, and a short cost ops checklist. They're in week 4 of onboarding and have a renewal check in ~5 weeks. Can we schedule a 90m hands-on that also leaves 15m for renewal signals?
Samir (Enablement): I can do Tue or Thu mornings PT. Prefer Thu 9:30-11:00 PT so EU team can hop on. 90m + a follow-up 30m office hours the following week would be ideal.
Gia (Solutions Eng): Thu 9:30 PT works for me. We'll need a 30m preflight with their infra person to validate API access and sample payloads. Recommend pinning rwd-7b-embed-int8 for the lab.
Marco (Renewals): I'll join the last 15m to capture adoption metrics and exec asks. Please reserve 10m for renewal notes and churn flags.
Renee (CSM): ops-bot, can you tentatively create the event and add a follow-up office hours slot?
ops-bot: Tentative event created: "PraxisAI Embed Evaluation + Renewal Pulse (tentative)" Thu 2026-05-07 09:30-11:00 PT. Office hours Thu 2026-05-14 09:30-10:00 PT. Invite: https://cal.redwood.ai/event/praxis-embed-2026.
Samir (Enablement): Draft agenda: 10m intros & success metrics, 20m data & metric review, 35m hands-on tuning + eval (notebook + sandbox), 15m rollout & cost ops, 10-15m renewal pulse.
Gia (Solutions Eng): Preflight checklist for Praxis infra: test embeddings key, sample CSV (<=8k rows), allowlist/VPC contact, and a small labeled set (10-50) for eval. If not received, we'll demo with sanitized examples and schedule a post-lab data validation.
Gia (Solutions Eng): Quick validation curl they can run:
```
# validate embeddings key + model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_EMBED_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-embed-int8","input":"sample clinical note"}'
```
Renee (CSM): I'm asking PraxisAI for payloads and an infra contact by Fri EOD. If they miss the deadline we keep the slot but run a sandbox-first lab.
Marco (Renewals): Flagging their renewal concerns: rising cost per query and variability in similarity scores. Samir, can you add a short "cost-by-config" checklist (batching, cache TTLs, quantization)?
Samir (Enablement): Yup 609 will add batching demo and a slide on safe quantization tradeoffs. Also bringing a notebook to compute precision@k on a small sample.
Renee (CSM): Any objections to Thu 9:30 PT?
Gia (Solutions Eng): No objections.
Marco (Renewals): I'll be there.
ops-bot: Reminder: preflight checklist due Fri 2026-05-01 17:00 PT.
Renee (CSM): Thanks team 44d I'll post the final agenda and the short feedback form here after PraxisAI confirms.
